description: Contract for devices that listen to events: sys_device_event_subscribe delivers each matching event to the device's ON_EVENT.

commands.label: On event
commands.description: An event delivered to the device: its key, its time and its payload. Runs while the device is suspended.

fields.label: Event
fields.description: EVT_TAG(module, code): the module's number in the upper 16 bits, the event's code in the lower

fields.label: Source
fields.description: What published it, as its module defines it (a device, a screen)

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Pin, channel or object on that source, 0 when it has none

fields.label: Time
fields.description: The board's clock when it was published: UTC once a client set it, else the time since the start

fields.label: Flags
fields.description: The events table's: bit 0 SYS_EVENT_NOTIFY (it matters to the user), bits 4..7 the lane (0 SYS, 1 DEVICE)

fields.label: Payload size
fields.description: Bytes of the payload after the header

fields.label: Payload
fields.description: The event's payload (its evt_data_<NAME>_t; runs to the end of the frame)
